text:
Maya: Quick sync 1M ARR healthcare prospect wants an onprem POC in a locked datacenter. Questions: media options, upgrade cadence, SBOM provenance, and cost uplift. Need our answers by EOD.

Jordan: They prefer USB courier for initial seed, then signed minibundles over an approved jumpbox. CVE SLA requested: 30 days for critical.

Eli: We can do encrypted USB + signed manifest. Full image ~12GB; minibundles ~<200MB. For strict transfer we shard into 500MB chunks with SHA256 manifest and provide a tiny reassembly utility.

Gwen: For cadence recommend monthly security minibundles, quarterly feature rollups. Emergency hotfix channel available (48-72h) at extra cost.

LegalBot: For supply-chain: proposed wording - "We provide a redacted SBOM and signer certificate chain. Signing is performed in FIPS 140-2/3 HSM; private keys never leave the HSM. HSM attestation and audit logs available under NDA."

Jordan: Commercials: one-time packaging fee + PS for chunking/test (estimate 10 14h) + 1.15x support uplift for concierge staging first quarter. I'll draft numbers.

Eli: Offline licensing: we generate signed activation tokens customers import via CLI. Add offline activation steps to the runbook. Example verify snippet to share:

```
sha256sum part_* > parts.sha256
redwood-verify --manifest parts.sha256 --cert signer.crt
cat part_* > bundle.tar.gz && tar -tzf bundle.tar.gz
```

Gwen: Note on rotation: offline cert rotation requires a signed rotation bundle and scheduled maintenance window; recommend quarterly rotation.

Maya: Plan: Jordan to send quote lines; Eli to produce runbook + chunk script and sanitized SBOM; LegalBot to finalize questionnaire text. Reply to customer tomorrow morning. Any blockers?

Ops: Reminder  do not include private key material in uploads. Use redacted logs only.

Maya: Thanks team. I'll assemble and send.
